Legend: P = Power;  A = Analog;  D = Digital;  I = Input;  O = Output

| Table 4-3. CPU-Power Supply Interface   | Table 4-3. CPU-Power Supply Interface                                                    | Table 4-3. CPU-Power Supply Interface   |
|-----------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| Signal Name                             | Type                                                                                     | Description                             |
| D, O                                    | Holds system power on                                                                    | PWRHLD                                  |
| A, I                                    | Startup pulse from the ON/OFF key                                                        | STRTUP                                  |
| D, I                                    | Digital startup pulse, used as interrupt to the CPU                                      | STRUPD*                                 |
| P                                       | 3.3 V system power                                                                       | V3_3                                    |
| P                                       | 5 V analog and interface power                                                           | V5_0/VANA                               |
| P                                       | Raw, unregulated charger voltage or battery voltage                                      | VMOT                                    |
| P                                       | 2.7 V backup power for RTC and non-volatile SRAM                                         | V2_7                                    |
| P                                       | Full supply, backed up by supercap                                                       | VSC time 5 V                            |
| P                                       | 12 V, low current supply for audio alarm                                                 | V12_0                                   |
| D, I                                    | Signal that indicates overvoltage, regulation problem on the power supply main regulator | OVRVLT*                                 |
| D, I                                    | Buffered AC on signal                                                                    | BACON                                   |
| A, I                                    | Voltage proportional to integration of battery charge/discharge current                  | IBATT                                   |
| A,                                      | Divided battery terminal voltage                                                         | VBATT I                                 |
| D, O                                    | Battery charger enable                                                                   | CHG*                                    |
| VFLOAT* D,                              | Set the main regulator voltage to battery float charge level                             | O                                       |
| ITGRST D,                               | Reset the charge current                                                                 | O integrator                            |
